components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main conversion CTA — diagnostic call, form submit.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button">בוא נבדוק יחד — אבחון חינם</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.72rem 1.65rem; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.015em; line-height: 1.2; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 1rem; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.07) 0%, transparent 38%), linear-gradient(165deg, #1e3a8a 0%, #1d4ed8 48%, #1e3a8a 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.14), 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06), 0 10px 28px rgba(15,23,42,0.14); transition: transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,0.14), 0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.1), 0 14px 32px rgba(15,23,42,0.16); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.72rem 1.65rem; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset, 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact form fields — glass variant on light CTA sections.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #0f172a; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(14,165,233,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(14,165,233,0.12); }

components.name: Home Card
components.description: Default content card — pricing, services, FAQ containers.
components.html:
עסק בצמיחה

נוכחות מקצועית וליווי מתמשך
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8edf3; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.03); transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #475569; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #dbe3ec; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Trust Pill
components.description: Hero trust strip and compact proof chips.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8edf3; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Unified section heading with one accent word.
components.html:
רוב העסקים לא נופלים בגלל שאין להם אתר — הם נופלים בנקודות החיבור?

תיאור קצר של הבעיה
components.css: .ds-section-header { font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: right; max-width: 48rem; } .ds-section-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 3.2vw, 2.375rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.028em; line-height: 1.18; color: #0f172a; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-accent { color: #2563eb; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.35); } .ds-section-sub { margin: 1rem 0 0; font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 1.4vw, 1.0625rem); line-height: 1.65; color: #475569; max-width: 42rem; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Homepage hash navigation — active state tint.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 1rem; transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0f172a; background: rgba(15,23,42,0.04); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #2563eb; background: rgba(37,99,235,0.08); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: JT Solutions reads as a premium Israeli B2B digital studio: confident, expert, and direct — never flashy for its own sake. Surfaces are clean white and cool-tinted off-white, typography does the heavy lifting in Hebrew RTL, and conversion paths are visually unmistakable.
keyCharacteristics: Light, cool-tinted canvas — not warm cream/sand
Single sans family (Heebo) across display, UI, and body
Navy-to-blue accent with restrained cyan focus rings
Flat surfaces at rest; hover lift via border + shadow shift
Primary conversion: diagnostic call / contact form

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue and Studio Navy together carry action and authority. They appear on CTAs, one accent word per section heading, and key interactive states — not as ambient page tint.

rules.name: The Cool Canvas Rule
rules.body: Section backgrounds stay white or cool #f8fbff. Warm cream, sand, and beige tints are prohibited.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Heebo carries every role. Do not introduce a second sans or a display serif without explicit system revision.

rules.name: The Balance Rule
rules.body: Apply text-wrap: balance on H1–H2; text-wrap: pretty on long Hebrew paragraphs.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadow on static body sections. Shadows appear on hover, focus, featured emphasis, or primary CTAs only.

dos: Do keep body backgrounds white or cool #f8fbff — premium Israeli B2B clarity.
Do use Heebo at 700–800 for headings and 400–600 for UI/body with verified contrast.
Do make the diagnostic CTA the visually dominant action on every conversion surface.
Do use flat cards with 1px borders; add lift shadow only on hover or featured state.
Do provide prefers-reduced-motion alternatives for all scroll and entrance animations.
Do test Hebrew headlines at mobile/tablet widths — no overflow from large clamp scales.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS templates — cream backgrounds, hero-metric cards, identical icon-card grids.
Don't use gradient text outside the hero accent line.
Don't add tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section.
Don't use numbered 01/02/03 section markers unless the section is a real ordered sequence.
Don't use glassmorphism, neon accents, or side-stripe colored borders as decoration.
Don't gate content visibility on animation.
Don't animate layout properties — transform and opacity only.
